status: reviewed complete pilot and source-backed analytical sizing; endpoint chart is supplied separately once its actual cohort finishes
metric: Maximum absolute true normal-force error over every native timestamp of 10 s, including startup; no downsampled metric

pilot100us.question: Does causal acceleration prediction recover force margin for the selected screw?
pilot100us.chartForm: line or grouped bars, numeric prediction-us axis and peak-error-N axis; clean and one fixed noisy seed are separate series
pilot100us.scope: S2kg/B.6kg/F50N/90deg, sharp 1mm x10mm at100mm/s, finite64MN/m cell, no external damping
pilot100us.caveat: One noisy seed is not a confidence interval or an all-seed qualification. Both prediction100us and200us pass individually with stochastic noise off; neither paired condition passes.

pitchSizing.question: How does pitch trade static heating against reflected rotating inertia?
pitchSizing.chartForm: separate single-unit charts for reflected-mass kg and current A; show catalog current as its own reference, do not use a dual axis
pitchSizing.scope: Analytical RE25 winding sizing, total rotating J1.58e-6kgm2,50N, no guide losses;90percent efficiency only a conservative sizing bound
pitchSizing.caveat: RE25 26.3mNm at 3mm lead and 90% motoring sizing gives 49.574597 N before guide loss; passing continuous current alone does not establish 50N continuous.

sampleUncertaintyNote: Reported stochastic RMS does not establish bias, scale accuracy, synchronization, phase or temperature allowance.
